headline: EPS falls sequentially but rises year-over-year
summary_short: Hankook Tire & Technology reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩2,288, down 19.4% q/q from ₩2,838 but up 53.4% y/y from ₩1,492.
summary_long: EPS of ₩2,288 fell 19.4% sequentially from ₩2,838 but rose 53.4% year-over-year from ₩1,492. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
